pick.headline: Kahan Commission blames Sharon for Sabra and Shatila
pick.summary: On February 8, 1983, Israel's Kahan Commission published its report on the Sabra and Shatila massacres, finding Defense Minister Ariel Sharon personally responsible for ignoring the danger of bloodshed.
pick.significance: Sharon resigned as defense minister. The report was a rare official reckoning with the conduct of the Lebanon war.
pick.fbis: The Middle East & Africa Daily Report of February 8, 1983, listed "Kahan Commission Findings Elicit Reaction" under Lebanon, with Ihdin radio and Radio Free Lebanon comment, and under Israel a run of reportage on the inquiry's findings on major figures, Yaron's comments and coalition reactions.
